capabilities: show unread badges on notes and folders in the file explorer
mark notes or folders as read and unread via context menu
run commands to mark all notes as read or unread
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer gives no visual indication of which notes are new or changed since you last viewed them.
summary: File-explorer badge plugin that marks notes and folders as unread when modified after last being opened.
